tour.step1Tagline: Your independent, local-first smart home hub
tour.step1Desc: Domus runs 100% on your local home network: zero cloud dependencies, total privacy, and ultra-low power consumption on Raspberry Pi 4.
tour.step2Tagline: All your devices at your fingertips
tour.step2Desc: Control lights, climate, switches, and monitor sensors in real time. Live state updates stream via WebSocket with zero page refreshes.
tour.step3Tagline: Save money with PUN and Nord Pool hourly prices
tour.step3Desc: Domus ingests daily hourly energy prices and automatically schedules flexible, heavy loads (heat pump, EV charging, water heaters) at minimum or negative cost hours.
tour.step4Tagline: Smart visual security without the cloud
tour.step4Desc: Low-latency WebRTC/RTSP streaming, polygonal motion zones, and local ONNX neural inference to detect people, vehicles, and packages with animated snapshots.
tour.step5Desc: Build rule-based triggers and actions, or design rich visual logic flows on the built-in Node-RED style SVG canvas with real-time dry-run simulations.
tour.step6Desc: Four armed modes (Home, Night, Away, Disarmed) with secure PIN protection and Zigbee direct binding that keeps sirens triggerable even during hub reboots.
tour.step7Desc: Place satellite microphones in rooms: wake-word recognition happens locally and commands automatically target the room where the speaker is located.
tour.step8Tagline: Zero-cloud device discovery and in-browser flashing
tour.step8Desc: Pair Shelly, Hue, Tapo, and Sonoff devices with 1-click on your LAN, and flash ESP32/ESP8266 microcontrollers directly from your browser via WebSerial.
tour.step9Tagline: Ready to enjoy your privacy-first smart home
tour.step9Desc: You can restart this tour or browse the complete user documentation anytime from 'Guide & Manual' in the navigation sidebar or Settings.

guide.title: Guide & User Manual
guide.subtitle: Interactive documentation and complete overview of all features built into Domus.
guide.searchPlaceholder: Search topics (e.g. tariffs, alarm, cameras, flowchart, zigbee...)
guide.noResults: No topics found for your search
guide.quickTipsDesc: Domus is designed to be completely autonomous and resilient to Internet outages.
guide.sec1Desc: 100% offline operation on Raspberry Pi 4 with SQLite WAL, in-memory event bus, and zero cloud data leaks.
guide.sec1H1: Embedded SQLite in WAL mode for ultra-fast concurrent queries.
guide.sec1H2: In-memory typed asynchronous event bus with bounded pools and circuit breakers.
guide.sec1H3: Zero external dependencies or subscriptions: everything physically stays in your hub.
guide.sec2Desc: Home organization into rooms and areas, real-time control of lights, switches, climate, and virtual helpers.
guide.sec2H1: Bidirectional live state updates over WebSocket.
guide.sec2H2: Supports lights, switches, climate thermostats, sensors, and covers.
guide.sec2H3: Custom virtual helpers (boolean switches, timers, counters, dropdowns).
guide.sec3Desc: Automatic ingestion of PUN/Nord Pool/Octopus hourly prices, 24h curve visualization, and load scheduling.
guide.sec3H1: Daily ingestion of PUN (Italian market) and Nord Pool day-ahead prices at 13:00.
guide.sec3H2: Interactive color-coded 24h pricing curve (red, orange, green).
guide.sec3H3: Flexible load scheduling (heat pumps, water heaters, EV chargers) at minimum or negative cost hours.
guide.sec4Desc: WebRTC/RTSP video streaming, polygonal motion zones, and local ONNX inference for people, vehicles, and packages.
guide.sec4H1: Low-latency WebRTC and RTSP streams with low CPU overhead on Raspberry Pi.
guide.sec4H2: Custom polygonal motion zones to filter out trees or road traffic.
guide.sec4H3: Instant mobile push notifications with lightweight animated WebP snapshots.
guide.sec5Desc: Flash Tasmota, WLED, and ESPHome onto ESP32/ESP8266 boards via USB with automatic Wi-Fi provisioning.
guide.sec5H1: Uses standard W3C WebSerial API in Google Chrome and Edge with zero external tools.
guide.sec5H2: Curated firmware catalog for Tasmota, WLED, ESPHome, and Sonoff Zigbee Dongles.
guide.sec5H3: Pre-flash Wi-Fi provisioning: devices connect to your hub on initial boot.
guide.sec6Desc: Declarative JSON DSL rule engine and SVG canvas for designing visual Node-RED style flows with dry-run tests.
guide.sec6H1: Triggers based on states, numerical thresholds, schedules, sun azimuth, and webhooks.
guide.sec6H2: Visual SVG flowchart editor with Bézier curves for intuitive logic inspection.
guide.sec6H3: Interactive dry-run simulator tracing data paths without triggering real relays.
guide.sec7Title: Alarm Control Panel & Zigbee Direct Binding
guide.sec7Desc: 4-state alarm panel with PIN codes, delay timers, and Zigbee direct binding for hub-independent reliability.
guide.sec7H1: Four security modes: Disarmed, Arm Home, Arm Night, and Arm Away.
guide.sec7H2: Customizable entry/exit delay timers protected by numerical PIN.
guide.sec7H3: Zigbee Direct Binding: sensors communicate directly with sirens even when the hub is off.
guide.sec8Desc: Local wake-word recognition for 'Ehi Domus', WebSocket audio streaming, and room-aware spatial resolution.
guide.sec8H1: On-device processing of 'Ehi Domus' wake-word with zero telemetry.
guide.sec8H2: Contextual resolution: 'Turn on the lights' automatically targets the room where you speak.
guide.sec8H3: Physical privacy mute switch with visual LED indicator.
guide.sec9Desc: Fast LAN discovery for Shelly, Philips Hue, TP-Link Tapo/Kasa, Nanoleaf, Yeelight, and Tuya Local with 1-click pairing.
guide.sec9H1: Passive mDNS, SSDP, and broadcast listeners discover Wi-Fi devices automatically.
guide.sec9H2: 1-click pairing with zero vendor cloud credentials required.
guide.sec9H3: Native support for Zigbee coordinator dongles and Philips Hue bridges.
guide.sec10Desc: Real-time collaborative checklist across family members categorized by grocery aisle with chore reminders.
guide.sec10H1: Live WebSocket synchronization across all family phones and tablets.
guide.sec10H2: Automatic supermarket aisle categorization (Produce, Dairy, Bakery).
guide.sec10H3: Voice quick-add: 'Add coffee to the shopping list'.
guide.sec11Desc: High availability (HA) architecture with Keepalived Virtual IP, delta WAL replication, and manual/auto promotion.
guide.sec11H1: Floating Keepalived Virtual IP (VIP) with sub-2s automated failover.
guide.sec11H2: Continuous streaming SQLite WAL delta replication to the standby node.
guide.sec11H3: Node health monitoring dashboard with 1-click promotion for scheduled maintenance.
guide.sec12Desc: Secure invite links, granular roles (Admin, Operator, Viewer), and AES-256-GCM encrypted backup CLI.
guide.sec12H2: Secure time-limited invite links to onboard family members in seconds.
guide.sec12H3: AES-256-GCM encrypted backup archives with path-traversal-safe restore CLI.
guide.sec13Desc: Unified management for Apple AirPlay, Google Cast, DLNA, and local speakers. Room sync, TTS broadcasts, and SQLite database registration.
guide.sec13H1: Register audio devices via Web GUI (+ Add Player), REST API (POST /api/v1/media/players), or direct SQLite query in the media_players table.
guide.sec13H2: Full local multi-protocol support for Apple HomePod, Google Nest, DLNA/UPnP Hi-Fi AVRs, and Raspberry Pi local DAC outputs.
guide.sec13H3: Whole-house priority voice announcements with Piper neural TTS, temporarily pausing ongoing music.
